fieldValues.title: A referenced Type version is not deletable
fieldValues.normative_statement: A Type version referenced by any instance in the repository MUST NOT be deleted. Name-keying makes the Record-to-Field edge Type-mediated: `fieldId` is recovered from `typeId` + `typeVersion` + key, so deleting the pinned Type version renders every instance of it unreadable. This rule governs versions with live referents only. (RFC-039 [R19])
